extension.description: Generate high-precision Git commit messages from staged or unstaged changes using GitHub Copilot CLI or OpenAI-compatible APIs.
command.generate.title: Generate Commit Message
command.openSettings.title: Open Settings
config.title: Copilot CLI Commit Message
config.uiLanguage.desc: Display language for extension UI, notifications, and settings panel.
config.provider.desc: Backend provider used to generate commit messages.
config.provider.openaiCompatible: Use OpenAI-compatible APIs such as Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama, or OpenRouter
config.language.desc: Language of the generated commit message.
config.language.auto: Match the language of recent commit history
config.style.desc: Format of the generated commit message.
config.style.conventional: Conventional Commits format with prefixes such as feat or fix
config.includeBody.desc: Also generate bullet-point body lines explaining changes and motivation.
config.model.desc: Model name for Copilot CLI. Uses fusion when empty.
config.reasoningEffort.desc: Reasoning effort level for Copilot CLI.
config.cliPath.desc: Executable path or command name of GitHub Copilot CLI.
config.apiBaseUrl.desc: Base URL when using the OpenAI-compatible API provider.
config.apiModel.desc: Model name when using the OpenAI-compatible API provider.
config.fallbackToUnstaged.desc: Include unstaged and untracked changes automatically when no staged changes exist.
config.customInstructions.desc: Additional custom instructions appended to the commit prompt.
config.instructionFiles.desc: Relative paths of repository instruction files to include in the prompt.
config.recentCommitsCount.desc: Number of recent commits to include as style reference.
config.maxDiffChars.desc: Maximum character length of git diff included in the prompt.
config.excludePatterns.desc: File patterns excluded from git diff collection.
config.timeoutSeconds.desc: Timeout in seconds for CLI execution or API request.
